posts.title_en: EOG CookieRun: Crumble hub: Crumble Dungeon sections
posts.summary_en: Global guild EOG. The Dungeon throws the whole collection at the Holy Golden Drop, scores total damage, and deploys the top 40 by combat power first; lower the levels of unwanted cookies below the 40th-place cutoff (no need for Lv.1). Controlled test on one account, 2026-08-13: 403,708,109 with a 10-star Oven Wanderer and Cool Mint deployed, 574,531,356 with both benched (+42%); a younger account showed no change. Heals and shields go to the lowest-HP ally, so divers soak the sustain; supports follow divers forward, out of the ranged dealers' range. Pomegranate's beam is read as choosing by synergy match first, which EOG flags as unconfirmed. Its simulator section: no controls; attack range sets a cookie's slot and move speed its arrival; an arena-wide shockwave throws the team back four times; the boss raises its own damage reduction three times (EOG's reading of game data: stacks to five, one application per source), so a run is decided in its first thirteen seconds; damage spent on adds scores nothing. Pets' passive effects and Collection bonuses apply to every cookie.
mechanics: Top 40 by combat power deploy first (EOG, 2026-08-14).
Boss damage reduction rises during the fight (EOG model).

posts.summary_en: Pre-launch page: Crumble Dungeon is the marquee PvE boss mode, the entire squad against the giant Holy Golden Drop, a score-attack challenge; scoring, rewards and mechanics are not yet documented on the page.

Crumble Dungeon lines: 2026-08-13 'Crumble Dungeon daily rank rewards now at 12:00 PM (KST)'; 2026-09-10 fix 'Cookies could be controlled by hand in Crumble Dungeon and Guild Conquest.' No Crumble Dungeon change on 2026-09-23 (1.4.002).

posts.summary_en: Items tied to the mode: the Crumble Dungeon Key ('your ticket to meet the Holy Golden Drop'), a score patch, a profile icon for 1,000,000,000,000 points, a title for 1,000,000,000,000,000 points, and a title for holding the weekly top 100 until the weekly ranking closes.
mechanics: Entry costs a Crumble Dungeon Key.
